scripts.prepare: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('.githooks') && fs.existsSync('.git')) { try { require('child_process').execSync('git config core.hooksPath .githooks'); } catch (error) { console.warn('Could not set git hooksPath:', error.message); } }"
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @otakuleague/shared-types build && pnpm -r lint && eslint scripts --max-warnings 0
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @otakuleague/shared-types build && pnpm -r test && pnpm test:hooks && pnpm test:scripts
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
